audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items all read 'Skill' while their whys hand every one of them to Zaahen, and Level 6 read 'Zaahen' while its why calls it a skill-check Lillia can flip.
audit.why: whys[2] 'Level 3 tilts to him'; whys[3] 'Levels 4-5 favour him'; whys[5] 'his durability and sustain out-scale your early chip'; whys[6] 'he crushes you in any one-on-one'; whys[4] 'Level 6 is a skill-check — your R Lullaby can flip his mistimed engage'. Packet levelChart reads Skill, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped to Zaahen and row 4 to Skill in both layers, with matching ratings, as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls his key threat 'Ultimate' as if that were an ability name, and never mentions the W pull, the E dash, the Q recast knock-up, the healing on his R, or the revive on his passive.
audit.why: The kit file gives no display names for Zaahen, but it does give mechanics: W is an 850-range stab that pulls enemies toward him on 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — longer than Lillia's 700-range E and the actual answer to her kite. E is a dash on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Q is an auto reset on 10/9/8/7/6 that heals him and can be recast so the next attack knocks up. R is 110/95/80 at 600 range and heals him for a portion of the damage dealt, which is what makes anti-heal worth buying. The passive stacks Determination for bonus AD and, at full stacks, lets him revive — so a committed all-in can be punished by a champion who stands back up.
audit.corrected: W pull named as the matchup-defining tool with range and cooldown; E dash cooldown, the R heal, and the revive now stated. No ability names invented, since the kit provides none.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer tells the player to hold 'your W dash' — Lillia has no dash, and her W is Watch Out! Eh Hee, a 500-range area hit.
audit.why: Her ownerKit lists W as a 500-range zone ability on 14/13/12/11/10 and Q as the source of her stacking move speed. Advice keyed to a dash she does not own is unfollowable.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Q move-speed stacks, which is the real mobility resource.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite two healing abilities and a heal-scaling passive.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.

edits.after: - His W pull reaches 850 units on 12-14s, further than your E — it drags you out of the kite, so break its line before you poke. - His E dash is 8-10s. - His R, 110/95/80s, heals him for part of the damage: buy anti-heal.

notes: The kit file for Zaahen carries no ability display names, only slots, so this page cannot use real names the way the other matchups now do — I referred to abilities by slot rather than inventing names, and focus.text now points at the W pull instead of the placeholder word 'Ultimate'. Two things worth a human call: his passive revive at full Determination is a major all-in consideration nowhere on the page, and the E dash carries a percentHealth flag that Riot's one-line description does not explain, so I made no claim about percent-health damage.
